title: The raid's board at dusk
lines: In The Little Raid, the board is now darker wood, so figures stand out. Your half is lighter and warmer than theirs.
While you drag a figure, the rows it belongs in light up. Sneak figures have none.

more.head: Also
points: Figures on the board cast a shadow.
In a fight, the lines between hexes fade.
Each zone has one outline around it.
Zones have their own marks: blobs for slime, ripples for puddles, specks for dust, glints for ice, drifts for snow.
Closed hexes are bare wood with a stump or moss.
The baize, the velvet, the gingham and the hall are darker to match.
